# Emscripten C/C++ toolchain notices

These notice/license files are copied without modification from the installed Emscripten 6.0.6 distribution used for the separate SID8580 research machine WASM. SOURCES.json records the compiler version, original relative paths, exact sizes and SHA-256 hashes.

The inventory conservatively retains Emscripten, musl, libc++, libc++abi, libunwind, compiler-rt, LLVM libc and mimalloc notices. It does not claim that every library or optional feature is linked. Rust standard-library notices remain separate in third_party/sidera/toolchain-notices. No library implementation, firmware, GPL SID oracle or game data is added here. These package-only notices do not change the machine or SID binary.
